title: Enemy HP curve smoothed past stage 500

changes.before: HP scaled as 18 * 1.10^stage at all stages (Stage 666: ~6.65e28 HP, effectively unkillable).
changes.after: Hybrid curve: 1.10^stage up to 500, then 1.05^stage past 500 (Stage 666: ~2.94e25 HP).
changes.note: Fixes the Stage 666 soft-lock where the HP bar appeared frozen. Enemies past 500 now scale gently instead of exploding.

changes.before: Base attack damage at 1x.
changes.after: All classes now deal 2x attack damage via BALANCE_ATK_MULT.
changes.note: Endgame enemy HP was outpacing player damage at high stages (e.g. Stage 666). This closes the gap.

changes.before: Warrior had +30% max HP and +15% defense, no attack bonus.
changes.after: Warrior now has +50% max HP, +30% defense and +15% attack.
changes.note: Makes the tank fantasy real: harder to kill and hits back harder.

changes.before: Tower enemies scaled at full stage power, making floor 1 nearly unbeatable.
changes.after: Normal tower enemies now have 30% of baseline HP, Tower Warden bosses 50%. Per-floor growth (18%/floor) is unchanged.
changes.note: Early floors are now a fair fight; the climb still ramps up.

changes.before: Tower enemies hit at full stage attack power.
changes.after: Tower enemy attack is now 25% of the stage baseline.
changes.note: Combined with the HP reduction for a much smoother entry.

title: Boss HP nerf, Kill Command bleed

changes.before: Bosses had 2.5× the HP of a normal enemy at the same stage.
changes.after: Bosses now have 1.5× the HP of a normal enemy — about 40% less boss HP at every stage.
changes.note: Normal enemy HP and boss damage tuning are untouched.

changes.before: Kill Command dealt 3× pet damage instantly and nothing else.
changes.after: Kill Command now also opens a bleeding wound for 10s: 5 ticks every 2s, each tick dealing 25% of the pet's strike damage.
changes.note: Beast Mastery, unlocks at level 30, 10s cooldown.

title: Rebirth Tokens, new gear rarities, pet breeding, better loot

changes.before: Mythic was the top gear rarity at every stage.
changes.after: Four new rarities above Mythic: Divine (stage 40+, x15), Cosmic (stage 60+, x22), Enduring (stage 80+, x45), Infinite (stage 100+, x65). Gear rolls are stage-gated, so the new tiers only appear once you reach their stage.
changes.note: Enchanting costs scale with the new tiers.

changes.before: Rebirthing gave no currency.
changes.after: Each rebirth now grants 1 Rebirth Token (no cooldown on rebirth). Tokens spend in the new Token Shop tab.
changes.note: Token balance shows in the Rebirth panel.

changes.before: No token shop existed.
changes.after: New Token Shop tab after Gear. Two staple items (Token Egg, Egg Bundle) plus four rotating offers that change every 24 hours. Sells exclusive titles, name effects, and eggs. Bought items are permanent.
changes.note: A countdown shows when stock rotates.

changes.before: Normal enemies had a flat 10% gear drop chance; no streak or special-enemy mechanics.
changes.after: Kill streaks add +1% gear drop chance per 25 kills (up to +10%, resets on death). 3% of non-boss enemies are now Radiant: gold-trimmed, guaranteed gear drop, bonus gold.
changes.note: Streak and loot bonus show in the battle HUD.

changes.before: Super Galaxy Pick (x25) was the top pickaxe.
changes.after: Three new tiers above it: Void Pick (x40), Cosmic Pick (x65), Thronebreaker's Pick (x100), bought with Super Galaxy Cores + gold in the Mining Shop.
changes.note: Master Miner achievement now counts all 10 tiers.

changes.before: Pets could only be hatched or bought.
changes.after: The new Pets tab has a Breeding Den: breed two pets for a gold fee (child keeps a parent's species, usually), or combine three same-rarity pets into one of the next rarity up (keeps the highest level). Combining asks for confirmation; special pets are protected.
changes.note: Celestial is the max combine rarity.

changes.before: The second gear/pet rarity was labeled "Magic".
changes.after: It is now labeled "Uncommon" everywhere it appears. No stat or save changes.
changes.note: Display-only change.

title: Pet rebalance, Starlight pets, staff role fix

changes.before: Pet stats grew at 1.12–1.21 per level — a Lv 85 Void Reaver displayed ~989M HP, a meaningless number that only ever appeared on the pet panel.
changes.after: Growth flattened to 1.055–1.09 per level. Same Lv 85 Void Reaver now shows ~153K HP. Display-only change; no effect on battles.
changes.note: High-level pet numbers stay readable from here on.

changes.before: Bond scaled flat per level (e.g. +35 HP/level) while everything else in the game scaled exponentially — at high level the bond collapsed to a rounding error.
changes.after: Bond is now the better of the classic per-level values and 2% of the pet's own stats. Levels 1–85 are virtually unchanged; from ~Lv 100 up the bond tracks your pet instead of fading out.
changes.note: Hunger rules unchanged: full bond above 50 hunger, 40% at 1–50, none at 0. Hunters with two active pets still get both bonds.

changes.before: Strikes scaled at 25% + 4% per pet level of your attack with no cap — a Lv 85 pet struck for 361% of your attack every 4s, far outshining the hero.
changes.after: Strike scaling capped at 150% of your attack per pet (cap reached at pet level 32). Pets stay meaningful without replacing the hero.
changes.note: Hunger, species, and Hunter pet-damage perks still multiply on top of the capped base.

changes.before: Starlight pets were a coming-soon teaser in the Pet Shop.
changes.after: Three real species: Star Wisp 💫, Luna Cub 🐻‍❄️, Astral Drake 🐲 — celestial natives on par with the Shadow line, hatchable from the new 500K-gold Starlight Egg (🌠) or rarely from wild eggs.
changes.note: Shadow demons remain teased as coming soon.

changes.before: The admin role could open the GM console but every grant, set-level, set-gold, and inventory action failed — admins had moderation powers but none of the console powers.
changes.after: Admin is now the senior staff role: owner > admin > gm > moderator. Admins keep ban/kick/mute and gain the full GM console.
changes.note: Staff-only; normal players see nothing.

title: XP bonus ceiling + GM console powers

changes.before: Gear XP capped at +40%, but the guild XP perk (up to +40%) and party XP bonus (up to +40%) multiplied on top — a fully geared, guilded party player could reach +120% XP.
changes.after: One +40% ceiling over gear + guild perk + party bonus combined. Tooltips still show true gear totals; the cap applies at gain time.
changes.note: Staff-run event buffs (double-XP weekends) still multiply on top — that's their purpose.

changes.before: Grants, set-values, dossier, mute, ban/kick; no record of what staff did.
changes.after: New: server-side staff audit log (survives restarts), full target inventory browser with per-item enchant set + removal, equipped-item enchant control, daily/weekly quest re-roll, and server-wide event buffs (1–10x XP/gold with expiry, announced to players at login). Every grant/ban/mute/kick is now audit-logged.
changes.note: GM powers only; normal players see nothing.

changes.before: 11 animated scenes (16 backgrounds in the Settings picker).
changes.after: 15 animated scenes. All 7 new scenes (Frostfall, Starfall, Blood Moon, Night Sky, Sunset, Woods, Water) now use photorealistic generated art with a slow cinematic Ken Burns drift and a soft vignette, instead of procedural canvas drawing. Art is compressed to ~872KB total so phones stay light. Pickable in Settings → Background and usable in battle through the 🖼️ My background card.
changes.note: Balance-neutral: visuals only. Respects Reduce Motion and Performance Mode (static frame).

changes.before: 3 earnable sets: Emberheart, Frostbound, Stormcaller (1% drop from any boss kill).
changes.after: 6 earnable sets. Added 🩸 Bloodmoon Regalia (lifesteal/regen — 3pc: +10 lifesteal; 5pc: +20 lifesteal, +15 regen), 💰 Gilded Fortune (gold/XP — 3pc: +40% gold from kills; 5pc: +80% gold, +40% XP), 🌑 Nightfall Shroud (crit/dodge — 3pc: +35% crit damage; 5pc: +70% crit damage, +8% dodge).
changes.note: Same 1% drop chance from any boss kill; regular enemies never drop set pieces. Existing sets untouched.

changes.before: 8 animated scenes (13 backgrounds in the Settings picker).
changes.after: 11 animated scenes. Added ❄️ Frostfall (drifting snow, glinting ice shards), ☄️ Starfall (meteor streaks over a twinkling starfield), 🌕 Blood Moon (giant red moon, drifting fog, rising ash). Pickable in Settings → Background and usable in battle through the 🖼️ My background card.
changes.note: Balance-neutral: visuals only.

changes.before: The sky flash drew, but the bolt line hit an undefined variable and never rendered (console error each strike).
changes.after: The bolt draws correctly on every lightning strike.
changes.note: Visual fix only.

changes.before: 90 — Rebirth unlocked at 90.
changes.after: 120 — Rebirth now unlocks at 120. All gates (title check, rebirth, UI) follow MAX_LEVEL.
changes.note: Rebirth still resets only level/XP and keeps all other progress.

changes.before: No levels above 90.
changes.after: Levels 91-120 continue from the level-90 value with a x1.47 exponent, continuous at 90. Level 100 costs ~3.48e15 XP, level 120 ~7.72e18 XP; level 120 is ~104,600x the level-90 cost. Total XP 1->120 is ~98,000x total 1->90, so the last 30 levels are a proper endgame grind.
changes.note: Levels 1-90 are unchanged. A raw x1.46-1.48 segment could never hit a 5-8x total target, so the new band is deliberately the steepest — the 91-120 climb stays honest even with the +40% party bonus.

changes.before: Enemy HP = 18 x 1.125^stage (x0.6 normal, x2.5 boss).
changes.after: Enemy HP = 18 x 1.115^stage (x0.6 normal, x2.5 boss).
changes.note: The flatter exponent cuts enemy HP ~9x at stage 250, ~15x at stage 300, and ~1,265x by stage 800 vs 1.125. Early game untouched (already one-taps), and the boss x2.5 multiplier plus incoming-damage auto-tuning (15-30% max HP hits, one-shot guard) still hold.

changes.after: 1-30 unchanged (80 x 1.30^(L-1)); 31-60 use x1.35 exponent; 61-90 use x1.44 exponent, continuous at both kinks. Level 60 needs ~3.1x more XP than before, level 70 ~3.6x, level 90 ~4.7x.
changes.before: 80 x 1.30^(L-1) for 1-60, then x1.42 exponent 61-90
changes.note: Targets the 30-70 climb players called too fast. Early game (1-30) untouched so new players still feel quick progress. Even with a full +40% party XP bonus, level 70 still takes ~2.5x longer than before.

changes.after: Up to +40% XP from parties: +8% per other online human, +4% per active NPC companion. Offline members give nothing.
changes.before: No parties (solo only)
changes.note: The v18 XP curve was steepened with this bonus active in the math, so parties speed you up without trivializing the climb.

changes.after: Capped at +40%
changes.before: Gear/stat XP bonuses capped at +50%
changes.note: Lowered to offset the new party XP bonus stacking on top.

changes.after: 90 — Rebirth now unlocks at 90. The steepened XP curve runs the full 1-90 range.
changes.note: Rebirth still resets only level/XP and keeps all other progress.
